subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using the parts of sentences from each column of the table below:
stimulus: Drug addiction is taking heroin, opium, etc. The drugs are a man to death. Young boys and girls have strong attraction for any harmful thing. The frequent taking of these leads grasped the young generation of our drugs country. means not only a national but also a global problem.
guide_solution: (a) Drug addiction means strong attraction for any harmful thing. (b) Drug addiction is not only a national but also a global problem. (c) The drugs have grasped the young generation of our country. (d) Young boys and girls are taking heroin, opium etc. (e) The frequent taking of these drugs leads a man to death.
